Needs changes before merge.

The Slot change in commit `3572ca334` is clear and well tested, but three blocking items prevent merge on this head: the branch carries stale commits from unmerged parent PRs (#3353 and #3387), the PR body has no before/after UI screenshots, and this P2 PR has no green heavy-lane record on this head against `upstream/main`.

### What looks good

- The Slot decision matches the planner in `crates/motion/src/machining2d/slots.rs:151-174` and `crates/motion/src/machining2d/face.rs:302-320`. For a 10 mm slot, a 4 mm cutter, 0.5 mm stock to leave, and a 2 mm stepover, `band(-2.5, 2.5, 0.0, 2.0)` gives `-2.5, -0.5, +1.5, +2.5` mm as one continuous serpentine pass followed by `slot_lap::wall_lap`. Issue #3357 allows a disabled row with a clear reason when an operation has no pass order.
- `crates/app/src/mcp/edit.rs:65-74` refuses `pass_start` on `OpParams::Slot` in both `add_operation` and `edit_operation` (including `"auto"` and `null`) before any command runs, so the job and undo history do not change.
- `crates/ui/src/egui_app/mill2d_more_page.rs:82` and `crates/ui/src/egui_app/pass_start_row.rs:23-24` reuse `no_pass_order_row` and display the reason without hover.
- Both new Slot tests (`slot_refuses_a_pass_start_with_its_reason_without_editing_the_job` and `the_slot_passes_tab_locks_auto_and_names_the_continuous_pass`) pass and catch local mutations of their guards.
- All committed Slot CL goldens (`slot_fullwidth_centerline.cl`, `slot_wide_channel_rows.cl`) and all existing Slot suites pass unchanged.
- `docs/decisions/3357-slot-pass-order.md` follows the decision-ledger format. The PR body includes `Changelog:` and `Fixes #3357`. No snapshot PNGs or `CHANGELOG.md` files changed.

### Local results merged with `upstream/main` (`ef1572114`)

| Check | Result |
|---|---|

| `cargo test -p camcraft-motion --lib` | 540 passed, 0 failed, 10 ignored |
| `cargo test -p camcraft-app --lib` | 297 passed, 0 failed, 0 ignored |
| `cargo test -p camcraft-app --test mcp` | 24 passed, 0 failed |
| `cargo test -p camcraft-app --test face_pass_start` | 1 passed, 0 failed |
| `cargo test -p camcraft-app --test offset_pass_start` | 3 passed, 0 failed |
| `cargo test -p camcraft-app --test golden_cl` | 33 passed, 0 failed |
| `cargo test -p camcraft-app --test roughing2d` | 7 passed, 0 failed |
| `cargo test -p camcraft-app --test blind_slot` | 4 passed, 0 failed |
| `cargo test -p camcraft-app --test mcp_slot_undercut` | 7 passed, 0 failed |
| `cargo test -p camcraft-app --test slot_dxf_sketch` | 4 passed, 0 failed |
| `cargo test -p camcraft-app --test slot_extension` | 5 passed, 0 failed |
| `cargo test -p camcraft-app --test slot_pick_refusals` | 3 passed, 0 failed |
| `cargo test -p camcraft-app --test slot_picks` | 8 passed, 0 failed |
| `cargo test -p camcraft-ui --lib` (CWD `crates/ui`) | 1438 passed, 0 failed, 8 ignored |
| `cargo clippy -p camcraft-motion -p camcraft-app -p camcraft-ui --all-targets -- -D warnings` | Passed (0 warnings in touched crates) |
| Heavy lanes (`cargo xtask gate heavy --base upstream/main`) | Not run - owed (blocked head; must run after stack refresh if heavy lanes are reached) |

#### Local mutations checked

1. Removed the `OpParams::Slot` arm in `crates/app/src/mcp/edit.rs:68`: `slot_refuses_a_pass_start_with_its_reason_without_editing_the_job` failed (`unknown field pass_start` instead of the Slot reason). Restored: passed.
2. Removed `no_pass_order_row(ui, "slot", SLOT_NO_PASS_ORDER)` in `crates/ui/src/egui_app/mill2d_more_page.rs:82`: `the_slot_passes_tab_locks_auto_and_names_the_continuous_pass` failed (`left: 0, right: 1` for `Pass starts at`). Restored: passed.

#### Extra suites run

- `testdata/` and importer files did not change, so no extra fixture or importer suites were triggered.
- Ran `golden_cl` and all Slot integration suites (`blind_slot`, `mcp_slot_undercut`, `slot_dxf_sketch`, `slot_extension`, `slot_pick_refusals`, `slot_picks`) explicitly; all passed.

### Requested before merge

1. **Refresh the stack after #3353 and #3387 merge (`crates/motion/src/machining2d/pass_start.rs:50-59`, `.claude/skills/camcraft-mcp/SKILL.md:152`, `.claude/PROCESS_VERSION`):** This branch sits on superseded commit `59b42c727` from #3353 (which still cuts full-width slots on split bands under `Outside` and edits `.claude/skills/camcraft-mcp/SKILL.md` without incrementing `.claude/PROCESS_VERSION`) and superseded commit `6e2d7d8f0` from #3387. Both parent PRs are still open (#3353 is a draft at `a91eb11d3`; #3387 is `needs-rework` at `e44df8e28`), and the GitHub base of this PR is the unmerged branch `issue/3316-offset-pass-start`. Wait until #3353 and #3387 merge to `main`, retarget this PR to `main` (before the parent branch is deleted), merge `upstream/main` into this branch, and re-run the gate on the new head.
2. **Add before and after UI screenshots to the PR body (`crates/ui/src/egui_app/mill2d_more_page.rs:82`, `crates/ui/src/egui_app/pass_start_row.rs:23-24`):** This PR changes the Slot Passes tab in `crates/ui`. Put before and after screenshots of the Slot Passes tab on your fork's images-only `pr-screenshots` branch and link them from the PR body. Do not commit image files to the PR branch.
3. **Record heavy-lane results if reached on the refreshed P2 head:** This PR is `P2` and its current diff against `upstream/main` reaches motion, `crates/app/src/operation/generate.rs`, and `crates/app/src/project/`, with no green `cargo xtask gate heavy --base upstream/main` run reported in the PR body. After refreshing onto merged `upstream/main`, if the remaining Slot diff still reaches any heavy lane, run `cargo xtask gate heavy --base upstream/main` and record the green result in the PR body.

### Notes (not blocking)

- `crates/ui/src/egui_app/tests/pass_start.rs:77` repeats the Slot reason string literal instead of importing `SLOT_NO_PASS_ORDER` from `pass_start_row` like the Face test does.
- `site/content/guide/operations/operations-2d.md:374` uses `centreline` (matching line 360 in that guide), while `pass_start_row.rs:24` and `edit.rs:68` use `centerline`.

A maintainer will approve and merge by hand.

Needs changes before merge.

This is a delta review of `a696d05f4`. The maintainer merged `bd2b774a8` into the reviewed head `3572ca334`, and resolved one conflict by hand. The class from `cargo xtask merge-plan --delta 3401 --reviewed 3572ca334` is DELTA. The hand resolution touches no production code.

### The delta

`git show --remerge-diff a696d05f4` shows one file: `crates/ui/src/egui_app/tests/pass_start.rs`. The resolution keeps both sides. It keeps the PR's `the_slot_passes_tab_locks_auto_and_names_the_continuous_pass`, and it keeps main's `the_adaptive_twin_offers_pass_start_and_says_the_trochoidal_refusal`. It drops the PR's old `the_adaptive_twin_has_no_pass_start_row_yet`, which main replaced, and it moves the `#3355` doc comment onto main's test. This is a correct union. No logic was hand-merged.

The effective diff against `origin/main` `bd2b774a8` is the same 7 files, +90/-3, as the Slot commit against its parent. `git merge-tree --write-tree origin/main a696d05f4` is clean against the newer main `6cfc0a6d4`, so the branch needs no further refresh.

### What looks good

- The earlier review's code findings still hold. `crates/app/src/mcp/edit.rs:68` refuses `pass_start` on Slot before any command runs, for add and edit, including `"auto"` and `null`.
- `crates/ui/src/egui_app/mill2d_more_page.rs:82` shows the shared row with the Slot reason, and `crates/ui/src/egui_app/pass_start_row.rs:32` holds that reason.
- The four before and after images in the body resolve (HTTP 200) from the fork's `pr-screenshots` branch at `a86a98586`. The UI code is unchanged since the "after" image, so the images still describe this head.
- The body has a `Changelog:` row and ends with `Fixes #3357`. The diff has no process file, no snapshot PNG, no `CHANGELOG.md`, and no new dependency. The new code has no `unwrap()`, `expect()` or `panic!()`.
- `docs/decisions/3357-slot-pass-order.md` records the refusal and the alternative that was dropped.

### Results

The quick gate ran on exactly `a696d05f4` in the warm refresh worktree. I verified the log at `gate-logs/quick-20261122-215338` and did not rebuild.

| Check | Result |
|---|---|
| Quick gate (`--base origin/main` `bd2b774a8`, 7 changed files) | 32 steps, 0 failed, 0 stalled (436 s) |
| app suites | 429 passed, 0 failed |
| UI suites | 1,510 passed, 0 failed, 8 ignored |
| Golden files | None changed |
| Tree after the run | Clean |

### Heavy lanes

`cargo xtask gate heavy --base origin/main --dry-run` reaches 212 steps, all `app heavy:`. The reason is `crates/app/src/mcp/edit.rs`.

The PR body records a green release run of 204 lanes against the parent `6e2d7d8f0` (46 tests, with #1950 and #2849 as expected fails). That run is not on this head, and the lane set is 204, not 212. AGENTS.md "Heavy lanes at review" counts this as stale, so this review cannot count it as a pass.

This review did not run the lanes. A quick gate was already running in the same worktree, and the dispatch said not to rebuild. The reached heavy lanes are **not run** on `a696d05f4`.

### Requested before merge

1. **Run the reached heavy lanes on `a696d05f4` (AGENTS.md "Heavy lanes at review"):** Run `cargo xtask gate heavy --base origin/main` on this head. Put the green result and the lane count in the PR body. The Slot code is the same as the `3572ca334` run, but the rule needs the final head.
2. **Update the body's readings for the refreshed head (PR body, "Verification"):** The readings still name `3572ca334`, 31 steps, 426 app tests and 1,464 UI tests. The current head has 32 steps, 429 app tests and 1,510 UI tests.

### Notes (not blocking)

- The last paragraph of the body still asks for the refresh. That refresh is done.
- `crates/app/tests/mcp.rs` is 769 lines, over the ~400-line guide. This PR adds 27 lines.
- `crates/ui/src/egui_app/tests/pass_start.rs:112` repeats the Slot reason as a literal. It can import `SLOT_NO_PASS_ORDER`, as the Face test does.
- `site/content/guide/operations/operations-2d.md:420` uses `centreline`; the code uses `centerline`.
- The PR is a draft. The author flags it ready.

A maintainer will approve and merge by hand.
